name: feature-grid-block
title: Feature grid block
description: What the product does, as cards: an optional Funnel Display heading and line over a grid of cards on the #171717 fill, each a title and a sentence, three or two across.
use_for: The section of a home or product page that says what the product does, one card per job.
never: Icons, colored cards or images inside the cards
More than six cards, or a card without a sentence
Claims the product does not make
source: Built from the library (card); the home page's three cards (copy from Post, Know what changed; Post, Every market; Ad, One photo)

<!-- The three jobs the assets name, three across. -->
<spyglass-feature-grid-block features='[{"title":"Know what changed before your next meeting.","body":"Spyglass follows the brands, creators, and niches that matter to you then turns the changes into a brief you actually want to read."},{"title":"Understand what is working in any category.","body":"Compare brands, creators, campaigns, and formats to uncover what is gaining traction, what is falling behind, and why."},{"title":"Search millions of creators in one place.","body":"Spyglass monitors millions of brands and creators across Meta Ads, Instagram, and TikTok."}]'></spyglass-feature-grid-block>
